title: Proposed Construction bridge metadata/schema fault campaign
status: PROPOSAL ONLY; no mutations or Godot execution performed

prior_coverage.qualification: Existing result reports 48 valid runs; 45 are source fault units, not48 unique metadata faults. It exercises static owner APIs, not bridge/schema independent anchors. This proposal did not rerun or accept that evidence.

execution_protocol_proposal: Astra/QA must inspect and authorize campaign adoption separately. Never edit production checkout for faults. Use a fresh isolated no-autoload clone per fault; do not load live Construction, Buildings, Definitions or Directory.

Check every original whole-file SHA256 before mutation. Each edit old string is an exact whole-source single occurrence; require count==1 and replace once. Multi-edit coherent cases are ONE fault unit and must apply atomically. Manifest generation checked only these textual assertions, not GDScript parsing/execution.

All source replacements preserve their declared outer types: untyped Dictionary/Array entries can hold malicious Variant values; typed Array values retain element type. Float literals occur ONLY in isolated refusal probes, never authoritative source adoption. Nevertheless only an actual clean parse/runtime execution can validate a refusal.

Author a dedicated cold bridge probe; existing metadata-owner-probe.gd expects all source faults to fail pure preflight and is unsuitable for independent-anchor/schema cases. Compare literal expected codes and detail prefixes here, not production REFUSE aliases.

For every case use Section.FramedOwner.new(-1), then set its PUBLIC owner property to literal1; keep all buckets empty. Section115-126 returns before any allocation for invalid constructor owner. This deliberately malformed owner1 frame reaches metadata/schema before shape without unsafe construction against broken schema. Record unchanged owner/buckets before/after.

Record Owner.column_source_metadata_refusal() independently. For expected pure-empty independent-anchor cases, explicitly assert it succeeds; otherwise earlier refusal would not prove bridge independence. Also call Owner.columns_refusal(Owner.Columns.new(false)) and require literal COLUMN_SHAPE, demonstrating direct shape-before-source priority.

For schema-family failures compare Bridge.framed_refusal(record).code AND detail byte-for-byte with a separately obtained Schema.schema_refusal(); also require the frozen code and stated detail prefix. Gate3 details must NOT acquire Construction metadata prefix.

Baseline-before and baseline-after: Schema and pure metadata empty; empty owner1 frame ->SAVE_COMPONENT_SHAPE; null frame ->SAVE_COMPONENT_SHAPE; owner0 empty ->SAVE_COMPONENT_OWNER. Separately use a canonical full clear frame from existing test_save_owner_construction.gd49-69 and require empty code/detail, with data unchanged. Baseline frame constructor zeros alone are not semantic defaults.

Each run must print every named observation, actual code/detail and expected result, an exact check count, and exit nonzero on mismatch. SCRIPT ERROR, Parse Error, ERROR, missing summary, timeout or crash means INVALID execution, never caught fault. Keep all raw logs, source hashes, applied patch and isolated clone identity. Restore/recreate baseline after each unit; verify main sources remain unchanged.
Do not change expectation to actual success if a TYPE_STRING-key case is accepted. Report a contract gap for Astra. No provider calls, production fixes or acceptance claims are part of this proposal.

limitations_and_gaps: Four StringName actual dictionary-key probes are required-refusal expectations with uncertain current behavior. Contract61 requires TYPE_STRING keys; construction1595-1644 and bridge655-680 do not explicitly inspect stored key types. Textual alias behavior cannot establish passing evidence.

Fact rows currently type-check every scalar but compare VALUES only at work/max-worker gate indexes. Contract61 wording every fact row exact shape/types/values is broader than contract55 gate-consumed scope. Do not inject unrelated footprint/base-storage value drift and call acceptance complete without Astra resolving that wording; such values do not drive this local validator.

Incoherent begin/count/child mutations prove generic schema forwarding only. Separate coherent owner partition mutations retain all schema arithmetic and are proposed to reach the independent bridge begin/count/child anchors. Do not disable Schema.schema_refusal to manufacture coverage.

Independent catalog-bijection branch is partly redundant with pure preflight plus frozen COLUMN key anchors. Ordinary catalog faults correctly stop at pure preflight. Requiring them to reach _catalog_bijection_refusal would give false expectations.

No claim of full mutation coverage: representative shared helper faults avoid repeating every material key/type failure in each bill family, while one exact-positive-content fault per family proves each bridge bill call is wired.
Section4 metadata does not prove section5 delivered ledger, saved Directory identity, capture/apply, retirement histories, allocation bounds or gameplay construction. Those remain separate evidence.
